name: Pizza Dough
subtitle: Paul’s favorite
notes: Because we all know yeast makes suspension in water, not a solution.

source.label: Back of the Kroger flour bag

steps.title: Suspend the yeast
steps.body: Suspend **2¼ tsp active dry yeast** in **¾ cup warm water**, stir.

steps.title: Add the remaining ingredients
steps.body: Add: **2 Tbsp extra virgin olive oil**, **1 Tbsp honey**, **1 tsp sea salt** and **2 cups all purpose flour**.

steps.title: Form the dough
steps.body: Combine until a ball starts to form, then remove dough from the bowl and dust lightly with flour.

steps.title: Rise
steps.body: Put floured dough in a lightly floured bowl, cover with a damp cloth, and place in a pre-warmed oven (less than 130°F). Allow dough to rise until almost double, approximately 45 minutes.

steps.title: Divide and roll
steps.body: Divide the dough into 2 separate balls and roll thin. Pierce crust with fork.

steps.title: Top and bake
steps.body: Top with toppings of your choice and bake at 450°F for 12 to 18 minutes.
